channel.name: BBC One NL
channel.title: Antiques Road Trip
channel.desc: Savvy antiques aficionados Hettie Jago and Ishy Khan are revving it up in sunny Cornwall for the start of an epic antiques odyssey. Lashings of antiques super-sleuthing kick off in the seafaring town of Penzance. Their ride for this trip? The ultimate in super-cool luxury, a 1960s Porsche 912. Prepare for some frugal buys as our pair take on a one-pound challenge. But will it be Hettie's design classic lamp or Ishy's Japanese geisha headrest that pulls in the punters at the auction?

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Earth's Greatest Spectacles
channel.desc: New England is the stage for the most incredible colour change on Earth - when the vivid greens of summer give way to the golds and reds of the fall. This film revels in the full glory of the spectacle, and reveals how this vibrant fiesta is created by the battles between the trees and the forests inhabitants.
